business_scope.primary_industry_name: Overseas Direct-Operated Hotpot Dining and Condiment Supply

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement between the Federal Republic of Germany and the People's Republic of China on the Encouragement and Reciprocal Protection of Investments (signed 2003, in force since 2005)

Convention between the Federal Republic of Germany and the People's Republic of China for the Avoidance of Double Taxation with Respect to Taxes on Income and Capital (1985, as amended; protocol signed 2014)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: German Money Laundering Act (Geldwäschegesetz – GwG) of 23 June 2017 (BGBl. I p. 1822), as last amended, particularly §§ 2, 3, 10–14, 20 and 23; Act on Limited Liability Companies (GmbHG) of 20 April 1892, as amended, §§ 5a, 8 and 10; German Commercial Code (HGB) §§ 17–24; Transparency Register regulations and fee ordinances under the GwG.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of valid passport or national identity document of each shareholder and all ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the country of origin / competent passport authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Convention of 5 October 1961) with certified German translation; consular legalization at a German embassy or consulate if the origin jurisdiction is not an Apostille state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and latest commercial register extract / registry confirmation of any corporate shareholder, including full UBO ownership chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign company registry or competent governmental registrar
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille with certified German translation; consular legalization for non-Apostille jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / certificate of legal existence for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign company registry or competent governmental registrar
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille with certified German translation; consular legalization for non-Apostille jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Signed and notarized beneficial owner declaration (UBO declaration) under § 20 GwG indicating each beneficial owner and percentage of ownership or control
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: German notary after remote/foreign notarial verification
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Foreign notarial signature apostilled or consular legalized where executed, followed by submission to the German notary/public register procedure

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney for incorporation and specimen signatures of each shareholder/managing director if acting remotely
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the shareholder's or director's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille with certified German translation; consular legalization for non-Apostille jurisdictions

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, managing directors, authorized signatories and ultimate beneficial owners against the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, UN Security Council consolidated list, OFAC SDN list where USD exposure exists, German BAFA/domestic sanctions and export control lists, and the German PEP database. Enhanced due diligence is required for politically exposed persons, high-risk third countries, complex ownership structures or unusual transactions under GwG §§ 11, 13 and 14. All screening results must be documented and retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Handelsregister / Unternehmensregister (electronisches Handelsregister); online portal: www.handelsregister.de and www.unternehmensregister.de; local filing with the competent Amtsgericht (local commercial register court).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed company name must be written in German/Latin alphabetic characters, be legible and pronounceable in German business usage, clearly distinguishable from existing registered names, and not misleading in relation to the company's stated object. The legal form suffix 'UG (haftungsbeschränkt)' must be included in the name and in the articles of association. Non-Latin scripts and ambiguous transliterations are rejected.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant or notary must first obtain the Amtsgericht's written reasoned rejection. If the issue is misleading content or insufficient distinctiveness, the name may be amended by adding a distinguishing geographical, descriptive or sectoral identifier and resubmitted for a new clearance. A formal judicial appeal ('Beschwerde') may be filed by the applicant against the registry decision within one month of written service under §§ 58–69 FamFG to the competent Oberlandesgericht; a further appeal on law ('Rechtsbeschwerde') lies to the Bundesgerichtshof in exceptional cases. The notary will manage the appeal and procedural deadlines. Reservation can be extended for up to one further 180-day period upon payment of the prescribed extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For a UG operating a full-service restaurant, a virtual office is not permissible as the sole registered or business address. The company must maintain a real domestic operational premises in Germany for the restaurant, registered under the Gewerbeordnung and subject to food-safety and trade licensing inspection. A professional virtual address may be used only as an ancillary correspondence/back-office address, provided the statutory German registered office and business address remain available for service of process and commercial substance requirements are satisfied.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate; approximately 30% likelihood of an unannounced on-site inspection during the first operating year, while a pre-opening inspection by the food safety authority and trade supervision office is virtually certain before restaurant operations may begin.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial deed of incorporation (articles of association, shareholder resolution, UBO declaration, incorporation filing instructions)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary tariff under the Notarkostenordnung (GNotKG schedule) based on the charter capital value and document volume, with market minimum fee benchmark.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial register filing and publication fee at the Amtsgericht (Handelsregister)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Court fee under the Gerichts- und Notarkostengesetz (GNotKG) and commercial register fee schedule.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and availability search / preliminary IHK name certificate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: IHK (Chamber of Industry and Commerce) / Handelsregister court
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory IHK fee schedule and prevailing market benchmark for commercial name clearance.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and/or consular legalization of foreign shareholder and UBO documents (passport copies, corporate registry extracts, good-standing certificates, powers of attorney)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority / German embassy or consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular fee schedule and foreign public-office tariff; prevailing market benchmark per document set.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified sworn translation of foreign corporate, identity and UBO documents into German (approximately 20 pages)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Sworn-translator rate per page under the Justizvergütungs- und Entschädigungsgesetz (JVEG) and prevailing market benchmark.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/UBO due diligence, PEP and sanctions screening, and Transparency Register initial submission support
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for low-risk standard retail dining entity with foreign UBO structure.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: German Act on Limited Liability Companies (GmbHG), Sections 1, 2, 5a (Unternehmergesellschaft), 6, 7, 8, 10, 11 and 35 ff.; Commercial Code (HGB) Sections 8 and 12; mandatory notarization under Section 2 GmbHG.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Handelsregister (Commercial Register) kept by the local Amtsgericht (Registergericht) of the registered office; electronic filings are channelled exclusively through the appointed German notary via the XJustiz secure platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Formation Deed (Errichtungsniederschrift) and Articles of Association (Gesellschaftsvertrag) together with the electronic Application for Registration (Anmeldung zur Eintragung) submitted by the notary in accordance with Sections 7 and 8 GmbHG.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The UG may be incorporated with a minimum nominal capital of EUR 1, fully paid in cash before registration; no escrow account is statutorily required where capital is subscribed in cash and the managing director declares that the funds remain at the company's unrestricted disposal. A nominal capital of EUR 2,000 is adopted for this project to evidence sound financing and cover early licensing costs.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF DE_UG, dated [DD] [Month] [YYYY]. The sole founder resolves: (1) the subscribed share capital of EUR 2,000 is fully paid into the corporate account; (2) the registered office is fixed at [street], [postcode], Berlin, Germany; (3) the company shall use the designation 'Unternehmergesellschaft (haftungsbeschränkt)' and must retain 25% of annual profits as a statutory reserve under Section 5a(3) GmbHG; (4) [Full name] is appointed Managing Director with sole authority to represent the company, to file for registration with the Commercial Register, trade license and hospitality permits, and to sign tax filings; (5) all pre-formation acts and costs are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of German Notary and Drafting of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Civil-law notary (Notar) competent for the district of the intended registered office pursuant to Section 2 GmbHG
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the notary to draft Articles of Association establishing a single-shareholder UG with the business object of operating a full-service hotpot restaurant and wholesale condiment supply. Submit founder identity documents, verify trade-name availability with the local Registergericht, and include the mandatory statutory reserve clause and the company designation 'Unternehmergesellschaft (haftungsbeschränkt)'.
required_dossiers: Valid passport or national identity card of each founder
Beneficial-owner declaration pursuant to the German Anti-Money-Laundering Act (GwG)
Proposed Articles of Association
Proof of intended registered address
AML/KYC questionnaire completed by the notary
Business plan and projected funding statement (recommended)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registergericht objects to the proposed company name, submit three alternative name choices within 10 calendar days; the notary will re-file the name reservation without additional notarial fees if handled within the same engagement.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Corporate Bank Account and Payment of Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: German credit institution or EU payment institution licensed by the Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (BaFin)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a business current account in the name of 'DE_UG (haftungsbeschränkt) i.G.' and deposit the subscribed share capital of EUR 2,000 in full. Request a bank confirmation evidencing that the funds are at the company's unrestricted disposal and may be used to pay formation and licensing costs; the confirmation will support the managing director's capital declaration before the Registergericht.
required_dossiers: Notarized draft Articles of Association
Passport or identity card of the managing director
Preliminary notarial certificate of formation intent
Beneficial-owner transparency statement
Bank-specific AML questionnaire and expected turnover declaration
Source-of-funds evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises compliance queries, supply the notarial certificate and the UBO declaration; a BaFin-licensed electronic money institution may be used as a temporary payment account provided it is a business account with full payment functionality, ensuring the capital proof is available before the commercial register filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Formation Deed and Appointment of Managing Director
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: German notary in the district of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the formation meeting; the founder declares incorporation of the UG, subscribes all shares, adopts the Articles of Association, and appoints the managing director by name. The notary certifies the formation minutes (Errichtungsniederschrift) and the Articles, obtains the signature specimen, and issues certified copies for the commercial register filing.
required_dossiers: Final draft of the German Articles of Association
Identity documents of all shareholders present before the notary
Notarized power of attorney if a shareholder is represented
Bank payment confirmation of the subscribed capital if payment occurred prior to notarization
Managing director declaration of acceptance of office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If formal defects are identified during the reading, execute a unilateral correction declaration before the same notary; if identity verification is challenged, provide an official passport extract or proof of address issued within the last 12 months and schedule a supplementary notarial session.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Registration with the Commercial Register (Handelsregister)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registergericht (Amtsgericht) of the registered office, filing via notary electronic gateway
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary electronically files the application for registration, including the formation deed, Articles, list of shareholders, managing director's declaration confirming unrestricted control over the share capital, and the written specimen signature. Pay the court fee invoice upon receipt; legal personality arises only upon entry in the Commercial Register, after which the company operates as 'DE_UG (haftungsbeschränkt)'.
required_dossiers: Notarized formation deed and Articles of Association
List of shareholders and beneficial owners
Specimen signature of the managing director
Managing director declaration pursuant to Section 8(3) GmbHG
Capital payment declaration and bank confirmation
Court fee payment order
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the court issues formal objections concerning capital proof or specimen signature, respond within two weeks through the notary with an updated bank confirmation or a fresh notarized signature specimen; a formal objection may be appealed by Beschwerde to the district court within one month.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Trade Registration, Hospitality Permit and Food Enterprise Notification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Trade Office (Gewerbeamt/Ordnungsamt) of the registered city, in coordination with the local Food Control Authority (Lebensmittelüberwachungsamt)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Gewerbeanmeldung under Section 14 GewO at least one week before opening, applying simultaneously for the Gaststättenerlaubnis for the service of alcoholic beverages in accordance with Sections 1–2 Gaststättengesetz. Notify the food control authority of the operation of the hotpot restaurant and the on-site condiment storage area; receive the trade certificate (Gewerbeschein) and the food establishment registration number before the public opening.
required_dossiers: Completed trade registration form (Gewerbeanmeldung)
Passport or identity card of the owner and managing director
Criminal record certificate (Führungszeugnis) if required by the authorities
Lease agreement or landlord consent for the premises
Application for hospitality permit (Gaststättenerlaubnis)
Kitchen layout and food safety concept
Site plan and seating capacity statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If reliability is queried, produce the criminal record certificate and prove that the appointed manager has no relevant offences; appeal an adverse trade-office decision within one month before the competent administrative court and, in the interim, operate the restaurant serving only non-alcoholic food and drinks until the hospitality permit is granted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Operational Inspections and Closing of Formation Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Building Authority (Bauamt), Fire Protection Office (Amt für Brandschutz), and the local IHK (Chamber of Industry and Commerce)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a change-of-use certificate of the leased premises to restaurant operations and commission the structural load assessment for ventilation ducting and cooking hoods. Arrange the fire-prevention inspection (Brandverhütungsschau) and occupational safety review; complete IHK membership confirmation, which arises automatically from the trade registration, and update bank records to the final legal name after commercial register publication.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the lease agreement or landlord consent
Plan of the premises and final architectural drawings
Kitchen exhaust system calculation by an HVAC engineer
Fire alarm and escape route plan
Occupational safety risk assessment under the Workplace Ordinance
Waste disposal and cooking-oil collection contracts
Commercial register extract after registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the building authority requires additional structural measures, engage a certified engineer, submit a remedial works protocol, and request a re-inspection within 30 days; if IHK assessment is disputed, file an objection within one month and request the municipal trade office to issue a correct membership determination.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipal Trade Office (Gewerbeamt/Ordnungsamt) jointly with the local Food Safety Inspection Authority (Lebensmittelüberwachungsamt) and the Municipal Building Authority (Bauamt) of the competent district administration
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Restaurant and Hospitality Operating License (Gaststättenerlaubnis pursuant to Sections 1–2 Gaststättengesetz) combined with the Trade License (Gewerbeschein under Section 14 GewO) and Food Business Operator Registration under Article 6 of Regulation (EC) No 852/2004

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Local Environmental Agency (Umweltamt/Untere Umweltschutzbehörde) of the district administration; advisory supervision by the German Federal Environment Agency (Umweltbundesamt)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Standard hotpot restaurant configuration classified as Exempt from a full EIA report under Annex 1 of the German Environmental Impact Assessment Act (UVPG); a case-by-case preliminary screening (allgemeine Vorprüfung) may be ordered only in sensitive urban mixed-use locations or where the operation triggers emission thresholds; a simplified environmental registration and building change-of-use notice are always required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Kitchen wastewater must pass an approved baffle-type grease separator in accordance with DIN EN 1825-2 before discharge into the municipal sewer, with effluent limits of fats and oils ≤ 25 mg/L and suspended solids ≤ 50 mg/L as fixed in the local Abwassersatzung; cooking fumes and odor emissions from hotpot hoods must comply with TA Luft immission standards, with grease filter efficiency ≥ 85% and exhaust air temperature ≤ 35°C at the discharge point; waste cooking oil must be stored in sealed containers and collected by an authorized waste company every six months under the Circular Economy Act (KrWG); kitchen ventilation ducts must be fire-insulated to L90 rating.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification (Brandverhütungsschau) by the municipal fire protection office covering two unobstructed escape routes of at least 1.40 m width, type-F extinguishers, and L90 fire-rated kitchen exhaust ducts; structural load clearance (Standfestigkeitsnachweis) for the false ceiling, hotpot hood supports and ventilation ductwork; occupational workplace clearance under the German Workplace Ordinance (Arbeitsstättenverordnung); food-handler hygiene certificates under Section 43 of the German Infection Protection Act (IfSG) for all personnel involved in food preparation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the municipal fire protection office covering hood extinguishing, escape routes, fire doors and building compartmentation; structural load inspection by a certified static engineer for elevated hotpot ventilation and duct systems; occupational health clearance in accordance with the Workplace Ordinance, including DGUV-compliant kitchen equipment testing and an approved personnel hygiene instruction program under Section 43 IfSG.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bundeszentralamt für Steuern (BZSt) – central services and VAT ID allocation; local Finanzamt (district tax office) – substantive tax registration and assessments; official filing portal: ELSTER – https://www.elster.de
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: After commercial register entry, the UG files the 'Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung' (tax registration questionnaire) with the locally competent Finanzamt through ELSTER or by paper, declaring corporate income tax, trade tax, VAT and payroll tax. The Finanzamt issues the Steuernummer (permanent corporate tax number). The UG then applies separately to BZSt for the Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer (USt-IdNr) via the BZSt online portal. A non-resident managing director or foreign shareholder may be required to appoint a German tax advisor to obtain and operate an ELSTER authentication certificate.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; the UG is treated as a German resident corporation with unlimited tax liability on worldwide income, subject to Körperschaftsteuer, Gewerbesteuer and Solidaritätszuschlag.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election is available under German law. For an UG, the principal statutory election is the formation of an Organschaft (corporate/trade-tax and VAT fiscal unity) where interdependence, financial integration and organizational integration exist. Other elections include the §19 UStG small-business exemption where turnover thresholds are satisfied and, for cross-border structures, compliance with §4k EStG anti-hybrid rules that override mismatch arrangements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No registration threshold applies to a UG; VAT liability arises from the first taxable supply under §§2 and 18 UStG. The only small-business relief under §19 UStG, available to qualifying entrepreneurs, requires prior-year turnover ≤ EUR 25,000 and current-year prospective turnover ≤ EUR 100,000 (2025 threshold onward); this is an elective relief and not a registration barrier.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, mandatory digital stamping or transaction-level API reporting to the tax authority is in force. Businesses must, however, maintain compliant electronic cash registers with a certified technical security element (TSE) under §146a AO and GoBD for POS records. Since 1 January 2025, all B2B taxpayers must be able to receive EN 16931-compliant e-invoices (XRechnung/ZUGFeRD); full mandatory e-invoice issuance applies to all German domestic B2B invoices from 1 January 2028, with an earlier 2027 requirement for taxpayers exceeding EUR 800,000 prior-year turnover. VAT returns are transmitted to the tax authority through ELSTER API, which does not constitute per-invoice government clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of goods qualifies for 0% VAT under §4 Nr. 1a and §6 UStG when the goods are physically transported to a non-EU destination and the UG retains conclusive documentary proof (Ausfuhrnachweis). Intra-EU dispatches to a valid EU VAT ID may be zero-rated under §6a UStG. Offshore restaurant-consultancy or condiment-supply services to non-EU entrepreneurs may be zero-rated where the place of supply is outside Germany under §§3a ff. UStG; dining and catering services physically performed in Germany remain standard-rated. Export refund substantiation requires evidence that the service is not connected to German real property and that the recipient is an entrepreneur established outside Germany.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ATLAS Ausfuhrzollanmeldung) with the Ausfuhrbegleitdokument (ABD) and customs release/export confirmation
Bill of Lading, air waybill, or CMR combined transport document showing final non-EU destination
Inward Remittance Certificate, foreign exchange receipt record, or bank payment confirmation proving receipt of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If the export-proof bundle is incomplete, contradictory, or fails the 180-day proceeds benchmark, the Finanzamt may deny zero-rating retroactively and assess 19% VAT on the original invoice, plus interest at 6% per annum under §233a AO; assessments remain open for up to 7 years, or 10 years in cases of evasion. Intentional misuse incurs criminal liability under §370 AO for tax evasion and §§26a/26b UStG for unlawful zero-rating or invalid invoices; fines and imprisonment up to 10 years may be imposed in aggravated cases.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Deutsche Bundesbank (Frankfurt am Main) as the German central bank within the Eurosystem, supported by the Bundesanstalt für Finanzdienstleistungsaufsicht (BaFin) for banking and payment-institution supervision and by the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action for foreign-trade and payment restrictions. The Bundesbank operates the external trade and payments statistics registry (Außenwirtschaftsstatistik) and the electronic reporting system for cross-border payments under the Außenwirtschaftsverordnung (AWV).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Germany provides full de jure convertibility and an open capital account under the EU free movement of capital and the Außenwirtschaftsgesetz (AWG). There is no general prior-approval regime for equity injections, profit remittances, repayment of shareholder loans, royalties, or trade payments, provided that applicable sanctions and reporting duties are met. The UG (Unternehmergesellschaft haftungsbeschränkt) may hold EUR and foreign-currency balances without limitation. Profit remittance frictions are fiscal rather than exchange-control: distributions to a non-resident Chinese shareholder attract German dividend withholding at 26.375% including solidarity surcharge, reducible under the Germany-China double taxation agreement to a treaty rate (generally 5% or 10% depending on qualifying shareholding and beneficial-ownership substantiation). The receiving German bank will require proof of tax filings and corporate formalities, but no central-bank conversion licence.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or conversion ratio applies to export proceeds under German law. The UG may retain export receipts in EUR or any foreign currency and may freely use them for operating costs, supplier settlements, or debt service. The statutory compliance duty is statistical: every individual payment from a non-resident counterparty with a countervalue of EUR 12,500 or more, including export receipts, must be reported by the German resident beneficiary to the Deutsche Bundesbank within five working days of the value date through the AWV electronic reporting portal. In addition, monthly status reports (Zahlungsbilanz-Bestandsmeldungen) must be filed when aggregate cross-border receivables or payables exceed the equivalent of EUR 5,000,000. No other retention, repatriation, or conversion obligation exists.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Trade Finance and Documentary LC Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: DZ BANK AG through a local cooperative bank (Volksbank/Raiffeisenbank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / SEPA Clearing and Retail POS Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MEDIUM as a supplementary treasury rail and LOW as a primary account. A non-German offshore electronic-money institution (EMI) without a BaFin licence or an EEA passport under the Zahlungsdiensteaufsichtsgesetz (ZAG) cannot lawfully provide payment accounts, acquire POS transactions, or issue German IBANs to the UG. Such platforms may be used only for ancillary cross-border vendor payments, CNH/USD conversion, and trade settlement through a licensed EU partner bank and must maintain client-fund safeguarding. The UG should maintain its primary operating account and merchant acquiring relationship at a tier-1 German bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under the German Anti-Money Laundering Act (Geldwäschegesetz, GwG), customer due diligence must be completed before a bank becomes active for the business relationship. Remote video identification is commonly accepted for EU-domiciled individuals and EU passport holders. For a non-resident Chinese managing director or beneficial owner of the UG, German banks generally demand at least one certified in-person identification, either at a German branch in the presence of the account officer or before a German honorary consul with notarized documents, apostilled passports, certified translations, a current Handelsregister excerpt, the notarized Gesellschaftsvertrag or Musterprotokoll, and full corporate-chain documentation. A Frankfurt or Düsseldorf onboarding trip of two to five banking days is strongly recommended to materially reduce AML/KYC friction and to complete signatory specimen signatures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident Chinese ultimate beneficial owner with large initial or subsequent capital injections into a low-capital UG structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and apostilled passport with certified German translation; proof of residential address; notarized articles of association (Musterprotokoll) and current Handelsregister excerpt; Chinese SAFE ODI/FDI registration certificate evidencing lawful outbound investment; Chinese shareholder corporate resolution and organizational chart; three-year bank reference from the remitting Chinese bank; notarized source-of-wealth statement supported by restaurant group revenue records, tax filings, and bank statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cash-intensive restaurant operations with substantial daily till cash, potentially elevating money-laundering suspicion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: TSE/DSFinV-K certified electronic cash register system fully compliant with KassenSichV; daily cash journal and cash-count reconciliation sheets; POS acquiring agreement from a licensed German acquirer; settlement statements matching cash and card turnover; documented cash-handling policy including daily bank drops and maximum cash float; inventory and purchasing records; payroll records; internal AML risk-assessment documentation and external tax advisor attestation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Recurring cross-border supplier payments to Chinese condiment manufacturers for hotpot base, chili oil, and seasonings in volumes that do not match restaurant turnover expectations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master supply agreements with legal entity details of Chinese suppliers; commercial invoices and packing lists; customs clearance evidence from E-Zoll/ATLAS including HS codes 2103.90 and 2106.90; bills of lading, air waybills, or CMR transport documents; phytosanitary and food-safety certificates issued by EU or German import authorities; detailed import-payables ledger; AWV payment-statistics report logs; independent price benchmark from Chinese customs or commodity valuation reports.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Irregular subsequent shareholder loans or equity injections from China that might be characterized as round-tripping or undisclosed financing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized shareholder resolutions approving each injection or loan tranche; Handelsregister filing and registration when a capital increase occurs; written loan agreements with arm's-length interest terms and repayment schedule; board authorization letters; AWV statistical filing confirmation for each payment; audited financial statements showing balance-sheet liability or equity traceability; tax advisor confirmation that the UG has no unapproved deposit-taking or NBFI activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The UG entering into FX forwards, NDFs, or derivative arrangements without a demonstrable commercial hedging need or internal governance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved treasury and derivative risk policy listing transaction limits and permitted hedging instruments; executed German master agreement for financial futures transactions (Rahmenvertrag für Finanztermingeschäfte) or ISDA 2002 with CSA; transaction confirmations linked to underlying procurement or revenue exposure; MaRisk-compliant risk-management documentation; monthly derivatives inventory and mark-to-market reporting to the managing director; EMIR trade-repository reporting confirmations; independent auditor's hedge-effectiveness and compliance review.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The compliant route for inbound FDI from China is a high-value SWIFT MT103 payment (or MT202/MT205 cover) from the Chinese shareholder's commercial bank to the UG's German operational account, carrying a UETR and a consistent payment purpose code classified as equity contribution, e.g. 'Kapitalerhöhung' or 'Stammeinlage UG' rather than 'loan'. The remitting Chinese bank must have a valid SAFE ODI/FDI registration and the German receiving bank must complete enhanced due diligence before value date. The complete capital-injection verification bundle includes the notarized foundation document, a current Handelsregister excerpt, German tax identification numbers (local tax office notice of USt-IdNr and W-IdNr), shareholder passport, Chinese SAFE approval certificate, and a bank reference. For an EU-based shareholder, a SEPA Credit Transfer (PACS.008) is permissible for the same purpose, subject to the normal AWV reporting threshold. The UG must not receive third-party payments from unrelated senders, and each injection must be traceable to the shareholder identified in the beneficial-ownership register.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for condiment imports and kitchen-equipment procurement should use the following clearing rails: (1) intra-EEA supplier payments via SEPA Credit Transfer (PACS.008) settled through EBA CLEARING or TARGET2, with AWV reporting if above EUR 12,500; (2) non-EEA open-account supplier payments via SWIFT MT103 with the beneficiary bank's BIC/IBAN, including UETR and purpose-code documentation; (3) irrevocable documentary credits under UCP600 for material consignments, issued by a German commercial bank via SWIFT MT700 and settled through TARGET2 or correspondent reimbursement; (4) local and international merchant acquiring for the restaurant POS, using Girocard via EBA STEP2 and Visa/Mastercard scheme clearing, settled daily in EUR; and (5) where required, conditional currency conversion through the bank's treasury desk. Supplier lending relationships, trade credit insurance, and cash-flow forecasting should be centralized in the German treasury to avoid liquidity fragmentation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/CNH and EUR/USD foreign exchange forwards for treaty-related trade payables and Chinese condiment procurement.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on EUR/CNH for hedging Chinese renminbi exposure where onshore CNY convertibility is restricted or CNH liquidity is unavailable.
Cross-currency basis swaps (EUR/USD and EUR/CNH) for matching long-term shareholder capital and treasury debt servicing needs.
Vanilla FX options, zero-premium collars, and forward fences to cap procurement cost volatility on USD-denominated oil and condiment purchases.
Short-dated FX swaps for day-to-day cash-flow and liquidity-clearing management between EUR, CNY/CNH, and USD accounts.

All derivative transactions must be executed with a German or EEA licensed credit institution or broker, supported by a signed master agreement (ISDA 2002 or German Rahmenvertrag für Finanztermingeschäfte), documented in a board-approved treasury policy, measured under MaRisk risk-management obligations, and reported to a trade repository under EMIR where applicable.

mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15.825% (Körperschaftsteuer 15% plus Solidaritätszuschlag 0.825%; trade tax Gewerbesteuer of approximately 14–17% is additionally levied on business income)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday or preferential deduction for restaurant operations. The UG profits are taxed at the flat corporate rate. Retained earnings are not immediately taxable at shareholder level until distribution. Trade tax is a deductible business expense. Off-season losses can be carried forward without expiry subject to annual offset restrictions. No Pillar Two effective rate relief applies below the OECD minimum.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (no statutory finite years; annual offset restricted under § 10d EStG: first EUR 1,000,000 of income offset in full, 60% of remaining income offset; § 8c KStG limits loss usage upon share transfers exceeding 50%)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: KSt 1 A (Körperschaftsteuererklärung für Kapitalgesellschaften) and KSt 1 E (supplementary sheet for economic control overfigurations) submitted electronically via ELSTER portal at www.elster.de
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due 31 July of the calendar year following the tax year. If prepared and signed by a professional tax adviser, automatic extension to 28/29 February of the second following year (e.g., for fiscal year 2023, 31 July 2024, extended to 28 February 2025). Discretionary further extensions may be requested under § 109 AO.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Local Tax Office (Finanzamt) identification number of the German UG/Hotpot restaurant entity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the German tax number only; no foreign tax identity number is required on this line. Non-resident beneficial owners must nevertheless ensure UBO registration data is current.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal-year-end month and day of the entity, usually 31.12 for companies filing under German accounting standards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a special fiscal year is adopted, state exact date. No extraterritorial or non-resident taxable period should be mixed into this German return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Pre-tax commercial profit according to annual financial statements, including all revenue from full-service hotpot dining, condiment supply, take-away transactions and related POS sales.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only the German entity's German-source business income. Foreign shareholders' local activities and income are irrelevant to this line and must not be consolidated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax add-backs such as 25% of total interest expense, 5% of exempt dividend income, rent/licenses/franchise costs and other qualified expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany royalties and management fees paid to overseas related parties must be justified by transfer-pricing documentation or deduction will be disallowed. Non-resident suppliers' invoices must meet German receipt requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions and offsets including trade-tax expense elimination, loss carry-forwards, depreciation adjustments and tax-privileged provisions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only deductions supported by German books and records. Amounts paid to shell-related companies abroad cannot be deducted without economic substance and beneficial-ownership proof.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable income after all adjustments and loss offsets. This is the base for Körperschaftsteuer at 15%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The taxable income remains a German entity-level computation; non-resident shareholder tax status does not change the German corporation's taxable base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Assessment of corporate income tax at 15%, solidarity surcharge at 5.5% of corporate tax, and allocation of trade tax base for separate GewSt 1 A assessment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter prepayments already made via ELSTER. Non-resident shareholders cannot claim foreign tax credits at the German entity level for taxes paid in their home country.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge (§ 152 AO): 0.25% of assessed tax per commenced month, minimum EUR 25, maximum EUR 25,000; late payment surcharge (§ 240 AO): 1% per month on unpaid tax. If no return is filed, Finanzamt may classify the filing as a forced assessment, estimate taxable income, add TP surcharges under § 162 AO, and initiate criminal tax evasion proceedings under § 370 AO.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 26.375% (25% Kapitalertragsteuer plus 5.5% solidarity surcharge on that 25%). Church tax is generally not imposed on non-resident and corporate shareholders. Treaty rates may reduce withholding: 0-15% depending on recipient's jurisdiction; EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive grants 0% withholding for an EU/EEA parent holding at least 10% for 12 months.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder must furnish before distribution an exemption certificate (Freistellungsbescheinigung) issued by the German Federal Central Tax Office (BZSt), or file a refund application in the event that tax was withheld. Required documents: current certificate of tax residency (Ansässigkeitsbescheinigung) from the foreign tax authority, a completed Form 'Entlastungsantrag' or 'Erstattungsantrag', proof of beneficial ownership, legal entity status, and shareholding period of at least 12 months for Directive relief. The BZSt conducts substance checks under § 50d Abs. 3 EStG; denial results in full 26.375% final WHT.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory WHT 15.825% (15% under § 50a EStG plus 5.5% solidarity surcharge); most German DTAs reduce royalty taxation to 0–10%, and § 4j EStG denies royalty deduction when the recipient is related and subject to less than 25% tax. Interest: ordinary debt interest paid to non-resident creditors is not subject to German WHT. However, interest on convertible bonds, participating loans and certain profit-dependent capital claims is subject to 26.375% capital-yields tax. Treaties generally limit source-based interest taxation to 0–10%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File: mandatory when annual cross-border intercompany transactions with related parties exceed EUR 500,000 for goods/supplies or EUR 50,000 for services. Master File: mandatory when consolidated group annual revenue exceeds EUR 100 million. Country-by-Country Report: filing required for groups with consolidated annual revenue of at least EUR 750 million. All documentation must be contemporaneous; submission on demand within 60 days (30 days for extraordinary transactions).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Germany does not enact an Anglo-Caribbean Economic Substance Regulation as a standalone statute; nevertheless, economic substance is decisive for corporate tax residence, permanent establishment attribution, treaty benefits and transfer-pricing functional analysis under § 42 AO and the base-company jurisprudence of the Bundesfinanzhof. A German UG/restaurant entity used solely as a letterbox with effective management carried out from abroad, no bona fide local decisions, no local staff or no operating risk capacity is recharacterized as a shell company, its income reallocated to the foreign principals, and treaty benefits denied under § 50d Abs. 3 EStG.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentional or grossly negligent submission of false or incomplete returns; systematic under-declaration of cash hotpot and condiment POS sales; unregistered electronic cash-register manipulations; failure to file KSt 1 A, GewSt 1 A and USt returns; withholding payroll taxes without transferring them; using non-certified fiscal software to reduce taxable turnover.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment up to 5 years or fine (§ 370 AO); particularly serious cases, including evaded tax amounts exceeding EUR 50,000, carry 6 months to 10 years' imprisonment. Penalty of 1.5% per annum interest on the evaded tax demand is assessed from the moment underpayment arose, and late-payment surcharges apply until settlement. For unregistered cash registers, additional turnover tax assessments of 10%-25% per § 162 AO may be imposed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Managing directors (Geschäftsführer) are personally liable for unpaid corporate taxes under §§ 34, 69 AO even for simple negligence. In cases of intentional evasion, the director's personal assets can be seized, a travel ban may be issued pending criminal proceedings, and imprisonment is a direct personal sanction. Non-resident directors can be stripped of travel rights, extradited and prosecuted in Germany without limited liability protection.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to prepare and submit Local File/Master File within statutory deadlines; refusing to provide intercompany cost and margin evidence; using a non-arm's-length profit split for the overseas hotpot royalty or condiment supply chain; charging excessive management fees to the German restaurant; maintaining cross-border contracts without functional and risk analysis.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under § 162 Abs. 4 AO the Finanzamt may estimate taxable income with adverse TP inference and impose a nontaxable surcharge of at least 5% of the tax increase, minimum EUR 5,000, maximum EUR 1,000,000; for intentional violations the surcharge may be doubled. Interest, royalty and license deductions may be denied under § 4j EStG, and the underlying tax assessment remains payable.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly approve deficient documentation or non-arm's-length pricing are jointly and severally liable for uncovered corporate tax, interest and late-payment surcharges. The corporate veil does not protect directors when they signed the declarations; criminal prosecution for deliberate misdeclaration is possible and can lead to personal fine, imprisonment and travel restriction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the German UG as an artificial letterbox for overseas investors with no German management, no local business decisions, no physical restaurant substance, no local payroll or risk-bearing capacity; artificially routing hotpot-franchise fees, condiment royalties and management fees abroad to derive treaty or tax advantages; entering into sham employment and lease structures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Subject to § 42 AO anti-abuse recharacterization: the UG's income is treated as directly attributable to the foreign principals, distributions are deemed disguised profit distributions, treaty benefits are denied under § 50d Abs. 3 EStG, and the tax authorities may disregard all artificial agreements. Reassessed corporate income tax, trade tax and withholding tax are levied at statutory rates, together with interest and surcharges up to 25% of assessed tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who execute or tolerate circular shell arrangements are personally liable for tax deficiencies caused by treaty denial. Non-resident beneficial owners risk extended 10-15 year limitation periods, forced transparency-register disclosure, travel bans, and confiscation of repatriated profits where personal guilt exists.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering and UBO Registration Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to register ultimate beneficial owners in the German Transparency Register (Transparenzregister); accepting large cash payments, tip pool conversion or condiment trading invoices without customer due diligence and without a money-laundering risk assessment; using anonymous POS settlement platforms; failing to appoint a Geldwäschebeauftragter when risk thresholds are met.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to EUR 1,000,000 per violation under § 56 GwG or up to double the economic benefit; serious/repeat violations may trigger the withdrawal of the restaurant license, blocking of merchant-acquiring contracts, and criminal liability for money laundering (§ 261 StGB) with imprisonment up to 5 years. For failure to file UBO reports, Finanzamt and Registergerichte impose daily penalty payments until compliance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Managing directors, including non-resident appointees, incur criminal and regulatory fines for non-compliant AML structures; personal disgorgement of profits, prohibition on holding management office in Germany, travel bans and seizure of personal assets are enforceable. The absence of a German director does not limit liability because the UG has a statutory managing director who must ensure UBO and AML compliance.
